text:

subject: Manna <> Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

I spoke with [SENDER] Higgins a few weeks ago about Manna's computer vision
efforts and how that focus is likely to grow as you expand geographically -
particularly with the easing of US commercial drone regulations and new
partnerships like Deliveroo (congrats by the way).

Following Meta's $15B deal with Scale AI, we've seen a sharp uptick in
interest around scalable, high-quality data infrastructure - especially
from UAV teams. We're working with ML teams at companies like Skydio,
Zipline, and Drone AG to streamline data curation, annotation, and model
evaluation - helping them move faster, improve model performance, and
reduce the engineering overhead.

I reached out to [SENDER] to grab a coffee while I'm back in Dublin this
Thursday (in from London), but he's out of office - so I thought I'd check
if you might be up for a quick chat to explore what a path to full autonomy
via computer vision could look like for Manna.

subject: Scale AI news
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

With Meta's $15B deal with ScaleAI, there's growing urgency around scalable, high-quality data infrastructure - & as we're seeing a wave of strong inbound demand - thought i'd reach out to explore if we can help in a similar way.

Curious to understand how you are thinking about training data / verification pipelines at [COMPANY] - & also happy to share our thoughts on where we see the industry heading.

Let me know if you're be open to a 30-minute chat later this week? Thursday or Friday quite open for me at the moment,

subject: Encord & AMP
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congratulations on the Southeastern Public Service Authority partnership. I
thought I'd reach out as I work w/ other AI waste sortation co's (Waste
Robotics, Glacier Robotics etc) helping them build similar CV models to AMP
for brand-level identification, or specific plastic resins classification -
I hope we can find time to connect.

A bit of context on Encord - we help 200+ AI teams label data 2x-10x faster
than in-house or first gen tools, resulting in shorter model iteration
cycles & improved model performance. We do this by offering an integrated
platform for data curation, annotation and model evaluation.

I typically support CTOs and Heads of ML who are looking to streamline data
pipeline efficiency -- especially when working with large data volumes
curation and annotation stages.

Are you the right person to speak with about this? If not, would you mind
pointing me in the right direction?
